comment: Wrath++ customization registry. Engineering seed for the first vertical slice (docs/wrathpp/MILESTONES.md, phase 3): two geoset categories of Legion 7.3.5's demon hunter looks. Every geoset group and option count here is UNVERIFIED until tools/legion_inventory.py has read the user's own 7.3.5 tables and tools/probe_geosets.py the Wrath++ client's models (docs/wrathpp/LEGION_OPTIONS_735.md). Stable ids: never reuse a category or option id for another look.

categories.name: Horns
categories.wrathpp_class_rule: every class: Wrath++ has no demon hunter class (a separate project); the look alone is offered

categories.name: Shape
